summary: Registered manually exported aggregate Attendee Signals workbook; all thirteen signal rows inspected without finalizing attendance.

version_metadata.provenance: User reports manually downloading the disclosed Google Sheets workbook as Microsoft Excel (.xlsx), then copying through WSL.
version_metadata.timestamp_basis: actual local registration; not historical browser retrieval time
version_metadata.online_equivalence: Unverified; no live Google Sheets content or provider version history accessed.
version_metadata.hash_verification: Independently calculated with sha256sum and Python hashlib; matches supplied hash.
version_metadata.inspection_method: Read-only standard-library ZIP/XML inspection of workbook relationships, shared strings, populated worksheet cells, date styles and empty drawing. ZIP integrity passed; no formulas found.
version_metadata.date_interpretation: G2:G14 use style 2, custom number format 164 yyyy-mm-dd, with Excel 1900 date system. Modern serials decoded using 1899-12-30; original serials retained. Dates supply no time or timezone.
version_metadata.privacy: Inspected worksheet contains aggregate cohort/need counts rather than attendee names, contact information or individual medical narratives. Small accessibility/allergy counts can still be sensitive; restrict unnecessary circulation and do not infer identities. Internal workbook person metadata was not copied into observations.
limitations: Registrations and required-on-site counts are source statements, not confirmed event check-ins or guaranteed attendance. Walk-ins are an estimate.
Confidence labels are qualitative, not probabilities or independent verification.
Accessibility/dietary signals concern overlapping existing populations; no additional people or final headcount calculated.
No person-level overlap/deduplication mapping, named support contacts, fulfilled-request evidence, or actual check-in outcomes supplied in these columns.
No record_version column or complete methodology/update history supplied; original download time and live-source completeness remain unverified.
Observed_at dates do not establish exact observation times; the August 26 forecast cannot be proven to predate the 12:00 business clock.
No spreadsheet parser dependency installed; XML inspection does not reproduce visual layout or recalculate formulas.
No vendor selection, approval, or final attendance decision performed.
